Fixtures for macOS Intel host health. The pmset, sysctl, top, memory_pressure and normalized scalar battery samples come from sanitized macOS 26.5.2 discovery. Battery IDs are synthetic. The native-architecture scalar is the verified Intel hw.cputype value (7); Apple Silicon reports 16777228, including when uname reports x86_64 under translation. Platform and formatted Docker JSON fixtures match the measured platform and engine budget; the Docker byte value is synthetic because discovery recorded rounded memory. The powermetrics sample is synthetic pending qualification with the owner-installed grant. Only scalar allowlisted values enter snapshots.
